top_signals.title: Rubio Says Ukraine Wouldn’t Exist Without US Support
top_signals.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the Trump administration’s support for Ukraine on Wednesday during a visit to India. Rubio told reporters the nation “as a sovereign state would not exist” without assistance from the US. Mica Soellner of Bloomberg Government has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
